name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
March 25, 2014
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Elissa Davey, Founder of Garden of Innocence National
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation recognizing Robbie Bush, the recipient of the 2013 Mayor’s Excellence in Service Award
P2.
Proclamation declaring March to be "Prescription Drug Abuse Awareness Month" in the City of Vista.
P3.
Presentation by Representatives of the 2014 San Diego County Fair
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Fiscal Year 2014/15 Sewer Capacity Fee Charges (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- ; and
2.
Buena Sanitation District Board Resolution No. 2014- .
C4.
Applications for Cabaret Licenses (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Live Entertainment Permitting Process (CC)
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Central Vista Business Improvement District (CVBID) Public Hearing (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive public testimony regarding proposed levy of assessments on businesses within the CVBID; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , confirming the CVBID FY 2014/15 annual report and levying the assessment for FY 2014/15.
PH2.
Amendment to Development Code Regarding Minor Use Permits (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to discuss the proposed amendment to the Development Code;
2.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2014- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 18.66 of the Vista Development Code Concerning Minor Use Permits"; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , establishing a fee for minor use permits for ABC licensed uses.
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
